Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنتَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma anta rabbee laaīlaaha illa ant, khalaaṭanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa w'adika masta-ṭa'u, a'uthubika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu-u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu-u bi-dhanbi, faghfirlee finahu laa yaghfiru-dhunooba illa ant
Sheet1.translation: O Allah! You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your slave and I am faithful to my covenant, and my commitment to You as far as I am able. I seek Your refuge from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You all of the favours that You have bestowed upon me and I confess to you all my sins. Forgive me, for there is none who can forgive sins except You.
Sheet1.virtue: This Du'a is also referred to as 'Sayyidul Istighfaar' (The Master Du'a of seeking repentance). The Prophet ﷺ added. "Whoever recites it during the day with firm conviction in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise; and whoever recites it at night with firm conviction in it, and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise."

Sheet1.Arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Sheet1.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illal-laahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul mulku wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
Sheet1.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone Who has no partner. Sovereignty is His and all praise is for Him, and He has full power over all things.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned regarding the one who says this one hundred times in a day, "...one will receive the reward of freeing ten slaves, and one hundred good deeds will be written in his account, and one-hundred bad deeds will be erased from his account, and on that day he will be protected from the morning till the evening from the Shaytan, and nobody will be better than him except for the one who recited this more than him."

Sheet1.Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bi hamdihi
Sheet1.translation: Glory is to Allah and Praise is to Him
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned regarding the one who says this one hundred times a day, "...all of his sins will be forgiven even if they were as much as the foam of the sea".

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhi laa yadduru ma'a ismihi shayun fil-ardi walaa fis-samaai wa-huwas samee'ul 'aleem
Sheet1.translation: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the Earth nor in the Heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever says this every morning and evening, nothing shall come to harm him on that day and evening (except that which Allah ﷻ has decreed).

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma inni asalukal aafiyata fid-dunya wal aakhirah, Allaahuma inni asalukal 'afwa wal 'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaay, wa ahlee wa maalee, Allahumas tur 'awratee, wa-aamn raw'aatee, Allahumahfathnee min bayni yaday, wa-min khalfee, wa-'an yameenee, wa-'an shimaalee, wa-min fawqee, wa a'udhu bi-'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and safeguard me from the things which I fear. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, and from my right, and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me.
Sheet1.virtue: Abdullah ibn 'Umar ﷺ narrated that the Prophet ﷺ would always recite this Du'a whenever he entered upon the morning and evening.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul huwal-laahu Ahad. Allaahus samad. Lam yalid wa lam yuwlad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kuf-uw-wan Ahad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, He is Allah, One and Indivisible. Allah, the Sustainer needed by all. He has never had offspring, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbil falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin naffa-thaati fil 'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin idha hasad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. From the evil of whatever He has created. And from the evil of the night when it grows dark. And from the evil of those witches casting spells by blowing onto knots. And from the evil of an envier when they envy
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbin naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril waswaasil khannaas. El-ledhi yuwas-wisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal jin-nati wan-naas
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind. The Master of humankind. The God of humankind. From the evil of the lurking whisperer. Who whispers into the hearts of humankind. From among jinn and humankind.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
Sheet1.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wa-bil islaami deenan, wa-bi muhammadin sallal-laahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabeeyan
Sheet1.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, and with Islam as my Religion, and with Muhammad (Peace and Blessings of Allah be Upon Him) as my Prophet.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever says this three times upon entering the morning and evening, then Allah ﷻ has made it binding upon Himself to please him on the Day of Resurrection

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَن لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma faatiras samaa-waati wal ard, 'aalimal ghaybi washa-haadah, rabba kulli shayin wa maleekah, ash-hadu allaa-ilaaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa sharrish shaytaani wa shirkih, wa-an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee sooan, aw ajurrahu ila muslim
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, Creator of the Heavens and the Earth, Knower of the unseen and evident. Lord of all things and its Possessor. I testify that there is no God worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil (sins) upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this Du'a to his close companion Abu Bakr As-Siddeeq ﷺ to say every morning and evening.
Sheet1.reference: [Sunan Abu Dawud 5067 and the addition is found in Sunan At-Tirmidhi 3529]

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Complete Reliance and Mercy Du'a
Sheet1.Arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
Sheet1.transliteration: Yaa hayyu yaa qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astagheeث, uslih-lee sha-nee kullahu wa-laa takil-nee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn
Sheet1.translation: O Ever Living One, O All-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all of my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment).
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this Du'a to his daughter Fatima ؓ to say every morning and evening

Sheet1.Arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Asbahnaa wa-asbahal mulku lillah, wal hamdu lillah, laa ilaaha ilal-laahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku, wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra maa fee hadhal yawm, wa khayra ma b'adah, wa 'audhu bika min sharri maa fee hadhal yawm, wa sharri maa b'adah, rabbi 'audhu bika minal kasal, wa-sooil kibar, rabbi 'audu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil qabr
Sheet1.translation: We have entered the morning and all sovereignty belongs to Allah; Praise be to Allah; None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this day and that what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and that what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the feebleness of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Hellfire, and from the punishment of the grave.
Sheet1.virtue: Abd al-Raḥmān b. Abzā (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said [the above]. (Aḥmad 15360)

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Invocation of Life and Death
Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahnaa, wa-bika amsaynaa, wa-bika nahyaa, wa-bika namootu, wa-ilaykan-nushoor
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, and by You we live and by You we die and unto You is our final return
Sheet1.virtue: Abū Hurayrah (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say [the above] when he would enter the morning.” (Al-Adab al-Mufrad 1199)

Sheet1.Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa-bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa ridaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midaada kalimaatih
Sheet1.translation: Glory is to Allah and Praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.
Sheet1.virtue: Juwayriyyah b. al-Ḥārith (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhā) reported: “The Prophet ﷺ left (my home) in the morning as I was busy in performing the dawn prayer. He came back in the forenoon and found me sitting there. He ﷺ asked: ‘Are you still in the same position as I left you?’ I replied in the affirmative. Thereupon the Prophet ﷺ said: ‘I recited four phrases three times after I left you. If everything that you have said today was put in the scales, [the above] would outweigh it.’” (Muslim 2140, Abū Dāwūd 1503)

Sheet1.Arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Asbahnaa 'ala fitratil islami wa-'ala kalimatil ikhlaas, wa-'ala deeni nabeeyinaa Muhammadin sallal-laahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa-'ala millati abeenaa ibraaheema haneefan musliman wa-maa kaana minal mushrikeen
Sheet1.translation: We have entered a new day upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (Peace and Blessings of Allah be upon him) and the faith of our father Ibrahim. He was an upright (in worshipping Allah) Muslim and he was not of those who worship others besides Allah.
Sheet1.virtue: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abzā (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said [the above].

Sheet1.Arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Hasbeeyal-laahu laa ilaaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbul 'arshil 'adheem
Sheet1.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. Upon him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
Sheet1.virtue: Abū al-Dardā’ (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: “Whoever recites [the above] seven times in the morning and in the evening, Allah will suffice him in everything that concerns him in matters of this world and the next.”
Sheet1.reference: [Sunan Abu Dawud 5081 – Mawqoof from Abu Darda ؓ]

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنتَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma anta rabbee laaīlaaha illa ant, khalaaṭanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa w'adika masta-ṭa'u, a'uthubika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu-u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu-u bi-dhanbi, faghfirlee finahu laa yaghfiru-dhunooba illa ant
Sheet1.translation: O Allah! You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your slave and I am faithful to my covenant, and my commitment to You as far as I am able. I seek Your refuge from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You all of the favours that You have bestowed upon me and I confess to you all my sins. Forgive me, for there is none who can forgive sins except You.
Sheet1.virtue: This Du'a is also referred to as 'Sayyidul Istighfaar' (The Master Du'a of seeking repentance). The Prophet ﷺ added. "Whoever recites it during the day with firm conviction in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise; and whoever recites it at night with firm conviction in it, and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise."

Sheet1.Arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Sheet1.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illal-laahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul mulku wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
Sheet1.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone Who has no partner. Sovereignty is His and all praise is for Him, and He has full power over all things.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned regarding the one who says this one hundred times in a day, "...one will receive the reward of freeing ten slaves, and one hundred good deeds will be written in his account, and one-hundred bad deeds will be erased from his account, and on that day he will be protected from the morning till the evening from the Shaytan, and nobody will be better than him except for the one who recited this more than him."

Sheet1.Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bi hamdihi
Sheet1.translation: Glory is to Allah and Praise is to Him
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned regarding the one who says this one hundred times a day, "...all of his sins will be forgiven even if they were as much as the foam of the sea".

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhi laa yadduru ma'a ismihi shayun fil-ardi walaa fis-samaai wa-huwas samee'ul 'aleem
Sheet1.translation: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the Earth nor in the Heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever says this every morning and evening, nothing shall come to harm him on that day and evening (except that which Allah ﷻ has decreed).

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma inni asalukal aafiyata fid-dunya wal aakhirah, Allaahuma inni asalukal 'afwa wal 'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaay, wa ahlee wa maalee, Allahumas tur 'awratee, wa-aamn raw'aatee, Allahumahfathnee min bayni yaday, wa-min khalfee, wa-'an yameenee, wa-'an shimaalee, wa-min fawqee, wa a'udhu bi-'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and safeguard me from the things which I fear. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, and from my right, and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me.
Sheet1.virtue: Abdullah ibn 'Umar ﷺ narrated that the Prophet ﷺ would always recite this Du'a whenever he entered upon the morning and evening.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul huwal-laahu Ahad. Allaahus samad. Lam yalid wa lam yuwlad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kuf-uw-wan Ahad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, He is Allah, One and Indivisible. Allah, the Sustainer needed by all. He has never had offspring, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbil falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin naffa-thaati fil 'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin idha hasad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. From the evil of whatever He has created. And from the evil of the night when it grows dark. And from the evil of those witches casting spells by blowing onto knots. And from the evil of an envier when they envy
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbin naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril waswaasil khannaas. El-ledhi yuwas-wisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal jin-nati wan-naas
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind. The Master of humankind. The God of humankind. From the evil of the lurking whisperer. Who whispers into the hearts of humankind. From among jinn and humankind.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times in both the morning and evening, then this will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

Sheet1.Arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
Sheet1.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wa-bil islaami deenan, wa-bi muhammadin sallal-laahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabeeyan
Sheet1.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, and with Islam as my Religion, and with Muhammad (Peace and Blessings of Allah be Upon Him) as my Prophet.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever says this three times upon entering the morning and evening, then Allah ﷻ has made it binding upon Himself to please him on the Day of Resurrection

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَن لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allaahuma faatiras samaa-waati wal ard, 'aalimal ghaybi washa-haadah, rabba kulli shayin wa maleekah, ash-hadu allaa-ilaaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa sharrish shaytaani wa shirkih, wa-an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee sooan, aw ajurrahu ila muslim
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, Creator of the Heavens and the Earth, Knower of the unseen and evident. Lord of all things and its Possessor. I testify that there is no God worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil (sins) upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this Du'a to his close companion Abu Bakr As-Siddeeq ﷺ to say every morning and evening.
Sheet1.reference: [Sunan Abu Dawud 5067 and the addition is found in Sunan At-Tirmidhi 3529]

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Complete Reliance and Mercy Du'a
Sheet1.Arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
Sheet1.transliteration: Yaa hayyu yaa qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astagheeث, uslih-lee sha-nee kullahu wa-laa takil-nee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn
Sheet1.translation: O Ever Living One, O All-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all of my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment).
Sheet1.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this Du'a to his daughter Fatima ؓ to say every morning and evening

Sheet1.Arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Hasbeeyal-laahu laa ilaaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbul 'arshil 'adheem
Sheet1.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. Upon him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
Sheet1.virtue: Abū al-Dardā’ (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: “Whoever recites [the above] seven times in the morning and in the evening, Allah will suffice him in everything that concerns him in matters of this world and the next.”
Sheet1.reference: [Sunan Abu Dawud 5081 – Mawqoof from Abu Darda ؓ]

Sheet1.Arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Amsaynaa wa-amsal mulku lillah, wal hamdu lillah, laa ilaaha ilal-laahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku, wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra maa fee hadhi-hil laylah, wa khayra ma b'adahaa, wa 'audhu bika min sharri maa fee hadhi-hil laylah, wa sharri maa b'adahaa, rabbi 'audhu bika minal kasal, wa-sooil kibar, rabbi 'audu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil qabr
Sheet1.translation: : We have entered the evening and all sovereignty belongs to Allah; Praise be to Allah; None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this night and that what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and that what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the feebleness of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Hellfire, and from the punishment of the grave.
Sheet1.virtue: ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to enter the evening, he would say [the above].

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Invocation of Life and Death
Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsaynaa, wa-bika asbahnaa, wa-bika nahyaa, wa-bika namootu, wa-ilaykal maseer
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, and by You we live and by You we die and unto You is our final return.
Sheet1.virtue: Abū Hurayrah (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say [the above] when he would enter the evening.”

Sheet1.Arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
Sheet1.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimaatil-laahit taam-maati min sharri maa khalaq
Sheet1.translation: I Seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
Sheet1.virtue: This particular Du'a is to be recited in the evening only. The Prophet ﷺ advised reciting this Du'a when staying in a place during the evening/ night. By doing so, nothing shall do him any harm until he moves from that place. Abu Hurairah ؓ also mentions that a man once came to the Prophet ﷺ and complained that he had got stung by a scorpion during the night. The Prophet ﷺ then went to teach him this Du'a and then mentioned to the man that if he had recited this it would not have harmed him.

Sheet1.Arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismika Rabbi wada’tu janbī, wa bika arfa‘uhu; in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ‘ibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn
Sheet1.translation: With Your Name, my Lord, I place my side (upon the bed) and with Your Grace I raise it; if You withhold my soul (cause me to die), have mercy on it, and if You let it go (let me live), then guard it as You guard Your righteous servants.​
Sheet1.virtue: “When any of you goes to bed, he should dust off his bed with the inside of his lower garment, for he does not know what might have fallen on it after he left it; then he should say this supplication”

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ. آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu amrī ilaika, wa alja’tu ẓahrī ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja’a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalta.​
Sheet1.translation: O Allah! I have submitted myself to You, I have turned my face to You, entrusted my affairs to You, and committed my back to You out of desire for You and fear of You; there is no refuge and no place of safety from You but with You. I believe in the Book You have revealed and in the Prophet You have sent.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated Al-Bara’ bin ‘Azib: “Allah’s Messenger said to me, ‘When you want to go to bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say: Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu ‘amrī ilaika, wa alja’tu ẓahrī ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja’a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitābikal-ladhī anzalta wa binabiyyikal-ladhī arsalta. If you should die then (after reciting this) you will die on the religion of Islam; so let these words be the last you say (before going to bed).’ I repeated it before the Prophet, and when I reached ‘Amantu bikitābikal-ladhī anzalta,’ I said, ‘wa rasūlika.’ He said, ‘No, but say: wa nabiyyikal-ladhī arsalta.’” [Bukhari 6311; also 247, 6315; graded agreed upon].

Sheet1.Arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Āmana ar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu’minūn, kullun āmana billāhi wa malā’ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulih, wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā, ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilayka al-maṣīr. Lā yukallifu-llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā mā iktasabat, rabbanā lā tu’ākhidh'nā in nasīnā aw akhṭa’nā, rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablina, rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fa-nṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīn.
Sheet1.translation: The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each of them believes in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers; “We make no distinction between any of His messengers,” and they say, “We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord; to You is the destination.” Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity; it will have what it has earned, and it will be accountable for what it has committed. “Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden as You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no strength to bear; and pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.”
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated Abu Mas‘ud al-Badri: “The Messenger of Allah said: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.” Agreed upon by al-Bukhari and Muslim.​

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul huwal-laahu Ahad. Allaahus samad. Lam yalid wa lam yuwlad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kuf-uw-wan Ahad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, He is Allah, One and Indivisible. Allah, the Sustainer needed by all. He has never had offspring, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated ‘Aishah: “Whenever the Prophet went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over them after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlāṣ, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nās, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body; he did that three times.” [Bukhari 5017].​

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbil falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin naffa-thaati fil 'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin idha hasad
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. From the evil of whatever He has created. And from the evil of the night when it grows dark. And from the evil of those witches casting spells by blowing onto knots. And from the evil of an envier when they envy
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated ‘Aishah: “Whenever the Prophet went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over them after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlāṣ, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nās, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body; he did that three times.” [Bukhari 5017].​

Sheet1.Arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismillah-hirahman-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbin naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril waswaasil khannaas. El-ledhi yuwas-wisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal jin-nati wan-naas
Sheet1.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind. The Master of humankind. The God of humankind. From the evil of the lurking whisperer. Who whispers into the hearts of humankind. From among jinn and humankind.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated ‘Aishah: “Whenever the Prophet went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over them after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlāṣ, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nās, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body; he did that three times.” [Bukhari 5017].​

Sheet1.Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Subḥānallāh
Sheet1.translation: Subḥānallāh
Sheet1.virtue: These counts follow the hadith of Ali and Fatimah رضي الله عنهما, where the Prophet ﷺ instructed them to recite 33 tasbih, 33 tahmeed, and 34 takbeer at bedtime, stating it is better than having a servant.

Sheet1.Arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh
Sheet1.translation: All praise is for Allah
Sheet1.virtue: These counts follow the hadith of Ali and Fatimah رضي الله عنهما, where the Prophet ﷺ instructed them to recite 33 tasbih, 33 tahmeed, and 34 takbeer at bedtime, stating it is better than having a servant.

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allāhu akbar
Sheet1.translation: Allah is the Greatest
Sheet1.virtue: These counts follow the hadith of Ali and Fatimah رضي الله عنهما, where the Prophet ﷺ instructed them to recite 33 tasbih, 33 tahmeed, and 34 takbeer at bedtime, stating it is better than having a servant.

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
Sheet1.transliteration: Allāhumma bismika amūtu wa aḥyā
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, in Your Name I die and I live.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated Hudhayfah ibn al-Yamān: When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to go to sleep, he would say, “O Allah, in Your Name I die and I live,” and when he woke up he would say… (see next dhikr). Agreed upon.

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Night Entrustment of the Soul
Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allāhumma khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyāhā; in aḥyaitahā fa’ḥfaẓhā, wa in amattahā fag̱ẖfir lahā. Allāhumma innī as’aluka al-ʿāfiyah.
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it in death; to You belongs its death and its life. If You keep it alive, then protect it, and if You cause it to die, then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated from ‘Abdullāh ibn ‘Umar that he instructed a man: when you take your bed, say this supplication; then he said, “I heard this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.” Recorded by Muslim.

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Bedtime Tawḥīd and Sufficiency Du‘a
Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ، وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samāwāti wa rabba al-arḍ, wa rabba al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm, rabbanā wa rabba kulli shay’, fāliqa al-ḥabbi wan-nawā, wa munzila at-tawrāti wal-injīli wal-furqān. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shay’in anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. Allāhumma anta al-awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shay’, wa anta al-ākhiru fa-laysa baʿdaka shay’, wa anta aẓ-ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shay’, wa anta al-bāṭinu fa-laysa dūnaka shay’. Iqḍi ʿannā ad-dayn, wa aghninā mina al-faqr.
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Mighty Throne; our Lord and the Lord of everything; Splitter of grain and date-stone; Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion. I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, there is nothing after You; and You are the Most High, there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near, there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debts for us and enrich us from poverty.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah رضي الله عنه: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would instruct when one of us wanted to sleep to lie on the right side and say this du‘a; in another wording he concluded, “Settle our debt and spare us from poverty.” Reported by al-Bukhari and Muslim. You can cite succinctly as: Sahih al-Bukhari (around 7414/7386 chapter variants) and Sahih Muslim 2713 in the chapters of adhkar before sleeping.

Sheet1.Adhkar: The Nighttime Praise for Provision and Protection
Sheet1.Arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā, wa kafānā wa āwānā, fa kam mimman lā kāfiya lahu wa lā mu’wī.
Sheet1.translation: Praise be to Allah who has fed us and given us drink, and who has sufficed us and sheltered us; how many there are who have none to suffice them and none to shelter them.
Sheet1.virtue: Narrated by Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he took to his bed, would say this praise. Reported by Muslim.

Sheet1.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
Sheet1.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak.
Sheet1.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
Sheet1.virtue: Reported from Ḥafṣah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, as well as Ibn Mas‘ūd and al-Barā’ ibn ʿĀzib, describing the Prophet’s bedtime practice of placing the right hand under the cheek and saying this du‘a. Collected by Ahmad and Abu Dawud. If you want the specific numbering from a given edition (e.g., Abu Dawud Sunan numbering), this can be added to your layout on request.
Sheet1.reference: Ahmad 26622; Abu Dawud 5045 (Hafsah); Ahmad 18472; Tirmidhi 3399 (al‑Bara’); Ahmad 37423; Ibn Majah 3877 (Ibn Mas‘ud)

Sheet1.Arabic: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَأَخْسِئْ شَيْطَانِي، وَفُكَّ رِهَانِي، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي النَّدِيِّ الأَعْلَى
Sheet1.transliteration: Bismi-llāhi waḍaʿtu janbī, Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī, wa akhsi’ shayṭānī, wa fukka rahānī, wajʿalnī fī an-nadiyyi al-aʿlā.
Sheet1.translation: In the Name of Allah I lay down my side; O Allah, forgive my sin, drive away my devil, release my pledge, and place me in the Highest Assembly.
Sheet1.virtue: his is part of the Prophet’s ﷺ prescribed bedtime adhkar for forgiveness, protection from the devil, release from what holds a person back (likened to a pledge or bond), and elevation to the Highest Assembly. It teaches entrusting oneself to Allah before sleep and seeking spiritual safety and status.
